title: Apply authored HideTempo to the opening GP8 tempo event
scope: Preserve legacy opening-tempo visibility through the existing GPIF Visible field with explicit authority for an authored opening event.
acceptance: When no explicit bar-0/position-0 tempo event exists, synthesize one whose Hidden state reflects Song.HideTempo. Cover both true and false with a non-default fractional BPM where applicable.

exclusions: No general tempo-authority redesign. Preserve the current text/BPM compatibility contract.
